meta.name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
meta.description:
In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

Ended · First aired 21 Oct 2026 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: Alfred Street Industries · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

On your server — Audio: Hindi, English (from file names)

videos.title: The Experiment Begins
videos.overview: Thirty participants arrive at the prison facility, ready to learn their fate. Eight are assigned to be guards — and the rest are put behind bars.

videos.title: The Rebellion
videos.overview: When the day shift and night shift guards can't present a united front, two like-minded inmates seize the opportunity to disrupt the balance of power.

videos.title: Abuse of Power
videos.overview: As the experiment reaches the point where the 1971 study spiraled, a newly empowered inmate stirs unrest and receives a controversial punishment.

videos.title: A New Order
videos.overview: Phase three brings changes that put everyone in the pod on edge as the day shift establishes control and former guards adjust to their new roles.

videos.title: Identity Crisis
videos.overview: A power vacuum emerges as the former inmates on the new night shift struggle to command respect. An ex-guard sows rebellion, threatening the hierarchy.

videos.title: We Have The Power
videos.overview: As the experiment nears its end, the guards head home and the inmates take control — but their newfound authority sparks a clash over what happens next.
